count_objects_related_to_given_relation :: list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrrelation -> bool

(lambda (lambda (clevr_gt? (clevr_count (clevr_relate (clevr_car $1) $0 $1)) 2)))

determine_shape_based_on_query :: t0 -> t0 -> list(tclevrobject) -> t0

(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_shape (clevr_query_shape (clevr_car $0)) clevr_cylinder) $1 $2))))
description: Determines a value based on whether the shape of the first object in the list matches a specified shape.

determine_shape_based_on_material_count :: list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrshape

(lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_material (clevr_if (clevr_gt? (clevr_count $0) 7) (clevr_query_material (clevr_car $0)) clevr_rubber) clevr_metal) clevr_sphere clevr_cylinder))
description: Determines the shape of an object based on the material count of the objects in the list. If the material count is greater than 7, it compares the material of the first object in the list with 'metal' and returns 'sphere' if they match, otherwise returns 'cylinder'. If the material count is not greater than 7, it compares the material of the first object with 'rubber' and returns 'sphere' if they match, otherwise returns 'cylinder'.

determine_size_based_on_relation_count :: list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrrelation -> tclevrsize

(lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_lt? (clevr_count (clevr_relate (clevr_car $1) $0 $1)) 2) clevr_large clevr_small)))
description: Determines the size of an object based on the count of objects related to a given relation with the first object in the list. If the count is less than 2, returns 'large'; otherwise, returns 'small'.

retrieve_object_relative_to_relation :: tclevrrelation -> list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrobject

(lambda (lambda (clevr_car (clevr_fold $0 $0 (lambda (lambda (clevr_difference $0 (clevr_relate $1 $3 $0))))))))
description: Retrieves an object based on its relation to other objects in the list.

filter_objects_by_small_size :: list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

(lambda (clevr_fold $0 clevr_empty (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_size (clevr_query_size $1) clevr_small) (clevr_add $1 $0) $0)))))
description: Filters a list of objects to only include objects that have a size of 'small'.

determine_output_based_on_left_relation_count :: t0 -> t0 -> list(tclevrobject) -> t0

(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_lt? (clevr_count (clevr_relate (clevr_car $0) clevr_left $0)) 2) $1 $2))))
description: Determines a value based on the count of objects related to the 'left' relation with the first object in the list. If the count is less than 2, returns the first argument; otherwise, returns the second argument.

determine_output_based_on_front_relation_count :: t0 -> t0 -> list(tclevrobject) -> t0

(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (count_objects_related_to_given_relation $0 clevr_front) $1 $2))))
description: Determines a value based on the count of objects related to the 'front' relation with the first object in the list. If the count is less than 2, returns the second argument; otherwise, returns the third argument.
